$comment: Machine-readable capability matrix for the LibertyNet developer portal. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every 'Implemented / Testing / Planned' badge rendered in the docs, the SDKs and the dashboard. Never hand-edit a badge in an .mdx file — edit this file and re-run `node tools/check-docs-drift.mjs`.
verified_against: https://registry.libertynet.ai (live probe) + https://libertynet.ai/demo-node (end-to-end loop) + https://libertynet.ai/coordination (live probe, plus a full Intent -> Proposal -> Commitment -> authorize -> Result -> Receipt run and the read-path authorization control, three consecutive green runs from an external client on 2026-08-14). See TEST-EVIDENCE.md. The 2026-08-13 re-probe corrected GET /api/v1/peers from implemented to not_yet_wired.

levels.implemented: Live on a public endpoint today. Anyone can call it right now and get a real answer.
levels.testing: Code exists and its own test suite passes, but it is NOT reachable on a public endpoint yet.
levels.planned: Designed, not built. There is no code behind this. Do not build against it yet.
levels.not_yet_wired: The endpoint IS live and returns 200, but its data source is not connected, so it honestly returns zeros/empties plus "source": "not_yet_wired". Reading it is safe; believing the numbers is not.

groups.title: Coordination — ask the network to do work
groups.auth: ed25519 signed envelope on every call, reads included; no API key, nothing issued
groups.note: The Intent → Proposal → Commitment → authorize → Result → Receipt loop, served by ln-coordination-gateway in front of a coordination core and a real three-node provider fleet. Authentication is a signed envelope carried in `x-ln-signed-request` (or, for the four operations whose body is itself the envelope, the body). There is no anonymous read: `session_id` is derived from content a third party can compute, so an unauthenticated read path would hand any stranger another party's Result and Receipt. The full schemas are in the OpenAPI document; this table is the index.

endpoints.note: Gateway liveness. Unauthenticated on purpose, and rate limited by address like everything else.

The contract version the gateway enforces and its own build version. Check this before blaming a signature: a client built against a different contract major fails as `signature_invalid`, which does not mention versions at all.
The authoritative coordination contract, served by the process that enforces it. `api-spec/libertynet-v1.yaml` is generated from this, not the other way round.
What `capability_requirement.capability_type` may be set to. Guessing wrong used to fail later, at `get_proposal`, as "no capability passed qualification" — naming neither the field nor the mistake.

Opens a session. The envelope's signer must equal `intent.requester_did`. Submitting the same Intent twice returns the same session with `duplicate: true`, because the Intent id is derived from its content.
Session state. Authenticated and bound to the session in the URL.
The recommended proposal plus alternatives, with whether authorization is required.
Returns the draft Commitment to sign. The body is itself the signed envelope.
The session's Commitment once one exists.
Authorizes the proposal and runs the work. Blocks for as long as the delivery takes — set no client timeout.
Cancels a non-terminal session.
The delivered result and its digest, once the session completes.

The final receipt, including the settlement figure. **That figure is an accounting record and moves no value.** Fuel settlement is deliberately not wired on this deployment: no rate card is provisioned, so nothing is charged (deny-by-default).
A polling snapshot of the session's events. It is **not** a push stream — no SSE, no websocket. Poll it.
Upload an input object. The signature covers the digest of the bytes, so a captured upload envelope cannot be reused to store something else under your name.
Download an object. Authenticated — an object id is derived from its content, so an unauthenticated read would serve any caller who could compute one.
Register an executable runtime package. Same digest-covering signature as object upload.
Endpoint is live and returns 200, but no credits ledger is connected. It returns settled/pending/estimated = 0 and "source": "not_yet_wired". Do not render these as earnings.
Live, returns count 0 and "source": "not_yet_wired". The read-only Evidence source is not connected.
Solidity contract exists with a passing 23/23 suite (libertynet-oracle/, Phase 1). NOT deployed to any public network — there is no address to call.
Pull-mode Pyth adapter with freshness guard. Same: tested, not deployed.

Reporter submission over HTTP is not built. Reporters sign on-chain today.

groups.title: Canonical demo node
groups.note: A real, publicly reachable LibertyNet node run by the project so the quickstart's discover -> verify -> act loop is true for people outside it. It registers, signs and heartbeats through the same public endpoints any node uses, and deliberately holds nothing of value.

DID, public key (base58 and hex), fingerprint.
Signs a caller-supplied nonce, so the reply is proof of possession rather than a replayable recording.
